KPI / value box

Source: R/value-box.R
shad_value_box.Rd

A compact stat card: a label, a large value, an optional trend delta chip, an optional icon, caption, and sparkline slot. Grid-friendly — drop several into a CSS grid for a KPI row.

Usage

shad_value_box(
  value,
  label,
  delta = NULL,
  delta_direction = c("auto", "up", "down", "neutral"),
  icon = NULL,
  caption = NULL,
  sparkline = NULL,
  size = c("md", "sm", "lg"),
  href = NULL,
  class = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

value

The headline value (string or number; tags allowed).

label

The stat label.

delta

Optional delta text (e.g. "+20.1%"). Rendered as a chip.

delta_direction

Trend for the chip: "auto" (default — inferred from a leading +/- in delta), "up", "down", or "neutral".

icon

Optional icon: a shad_icon() name or a tag, pinned top-right.

caption

Optional muted caption line below the value.

sparkline

Optional tag/output filling a small strip at the bottom (e.g. an inline <svg> or a plotOutput()).

size

"md" (default), "sm", or "lg".

href

Optional URL; makes the whole box a link.

class

Extra CSS classes.

...

Extra attributes on the root.

Value

A value-box tag.

See also

Other shadshiny dashboard: shad_chart_container(), shad_mini_donut(), shad_sparkline(), shad_timeline(), shad_timeline_item()

Examples

shad_value_box("$45,231.89", "Total revenue", delta = "+20.1%",
               caption = "vs. last month")
#> <div class="shad-value-box">
#>   <div class="shad-value-box__label">Total revenue</div>
#>   <div class="shad-value-box__value">
#>     $45,231.89
#>     <span class="shad-value-box__delta" data-trend="up">
#>       <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 17L17 7M7 7h10v10"/></svg>
#>       +20.1%
#>     </span>
#>   </div>
#>   <div class="shad-value-box__caption">vs. last month</div>
#> </div>
